messages.subject: Shiny Proxy Settings
parts:
Hi, I'm running Shiny from inside RStudio on Windows.
It is reading a proxy configuration from somewhere, but I can't figure out where from, and I can't find a reference on the web. The only one refers Shiny Server pro, and is about using the http_proxy environment variable, which isn't set.

Any ideas?

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Proxy Settings
parts: You can configure R to use a proxy layer by editing your .Renviron file, see https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/articles/200488488-Configuring-R-to-Use-an-HTTP-Proxy for detailed instructions.
